_description: Default window arrangement — the tab set for the `default-window`/`0-default-tabs` command (New Default Window, Ctrl-Shift-N). The home-module builds a qutebrowser alias from this: the FIRST url opens a new window (open -w), the rest open as tabs (open -t). Keep in sync with the fresh-boot layout (ba_flakes_desktop default-session.json qutebrowser window). Default set = bookmarks dashboard + local dev server + Qwant.
